messages:
Ari Patel: FYI handoff for Acme Corp (Enterprise, signed 2026-02-10). Key signals: onboarding 60% complete, data connector failing for two warehouses, usage below P90; renewal date 2027-02-10. Need CS owner + engineering triage. Attach: contract id #AC-2026-001.
Maya Chen: taking point for CS. Will schedule kickoff and own success plan. Quick ask: who on Eng to ping for the connector bug? @Jules?
Jules Rivera: I can take triage. Describe the failure briefly or drop logs.
Ari Patel: error seen when customer runs batch sync -> 502 from connector service. Short log: ``POST /sync -> 502 Bad Gateway, upstream timeout after 30s``. They've tried increasing retry window, no luck.
Samir Gupta: I'll open a support ticket and collect full logs + config (warehouse names, connector version). Will reference JIRA: CSUP-4821 and tag Eng.
Maya Chen: next steps I propose: 1) Support (Samir) gathers logs + run repro; 2) Eng (Jules) triages bug and proposes hotfix/backport if needed; 3) CS (Maya) runs weekly enablement sessions with Acme PM; 4) CS -> Sales to update renewal risk by end of month. Owners assigned below.
Maya Chen: Owners: CS = Maya Chen, Support = Samir Gupta, Eng = Jules Rivera, Sales followup = Ari Patel. Risk level: amber (medium) until connector stable and usage recovers. If unresolved in 3 weeks -> escalate to red.
Samir Gupta: opened ticket SUP-9981 with initial logs, cc'ing @Jules and @Maya. Link: https://support.redwood.ai/SUP-9981
Jules Rivera: I'll look this sprint. If it's a timeout, temporary mitigation: increase upstream timeout + add retry/backoff. I'll post PR or rollback plan in the ticket.
Maya Chen: I'll schedule the customer sync for Thursday 4pm PT, invite includes customer PM + solutions engineer. Action: Maya to send invite, Samir to add repro steps to ticket, Jules to update ticket with ETA and mitigation.
Ari Patel: Thanks team. I'll also flag renewal manager (Lee) in 2 weeks with an update. :thumbsup:
csm-bot: Onboarding progress updated -> 60% complete (tasks remaining: data connector, validation suite).
Maya Chen: tagging for CS enablement: please prepare a short runbook and a 10-min demo for the connector once patch is ready. I'll add to CS enablement tracker.
Jules Rivera: noted. I'll aim for draft runbook in ticket by EOD Wednesday.
Maya Chen: great — will follow up after Thursday sync. Thanks everyone. :heart:
